description: ddareungi: run the host-installed /opt/ddareungi/bin/deploy.sh only (blue/green deploy, forced restart, maintenance on/off). Parameters are pattern-checked by SSM; the script's sha256 must match the deploying commit. Template from deploy/aws/ssm-document-deploy.json.

backendRef.description: Backend image by digest (<registry>/<repo>@sha256:<64 hex>), or none for maintenance-on/off

webRef.description: Web bundle image by digest, or none

scriptSha256.description: sha256 of deploy/ec2/deploy.sh in the deploying commit; the host copy must match

executionTimeout.description: Seconds before the run is stopped

runCommand: if [ ! -x "$script" ]; then echo "$script is missing; install it as described in deploy/ec2/bootstrap.md" >&2; exit 3; fi
if [ "$have" != "$want" ]; then echo "$script sha256 $have does not match the deploying commit ($want); update the host script (docs/deploy-ec2.md, deploy.sh update)" >&2; exit 3; fi
if [ "$backend" = none ]; then echo "backendRef is required for $action" >&2; exit 2; fi
